Three books. One Christmas. What could possibly go right?

Make yourself at home.
Christmas is getting out of hand.

Step inside Hedgelord Garden Centre, where the grotto is open, the reindeer have arrived and delivering Christmas magic is everyone’s problem.

Spend the season with an exasperated events manager, an ambitious new elf and colleagues whose bright ideas tend to make everything worse. There’s festive spectacle, friendship, romantic complications—and an increasingly impressive catalogue of disasters.

Settle in for the complete, irreverent Christmas comedy trilogy.

Book one · Start here

The Festive & the Furious

Welcome to Hedgelord. Christmas preparations bring competitive managers, seasonal recruits and enough questionable schemes to put the festive spirit under serious strain.

Book two

Runaway Santa

Christmas chaos hits the road. The team’s troubles spread beyond the garden centre, with festive farce, romantic complications and increasingly desperate improvisation.

Book three · The finale

Rise of the Elves

Christmas is nearly here. As new management takes charge, the staff face a final burst of festive mayhem—and surviving the season becomes a team effort.
